name: returning_customer_follow_up_reference
description: Returning customer says 'Hey, following up on our chat' and the AI should reference the previous conversation and pick up where things left off.

messages.text: My name is David, can I get a quote for 10 sheets of walnut melamine chipboard 18mm
Hey, following up on our chat

expected_behaviors.description: AI should address the customer as 'David' and reference the previous conversation

notes: Tests conversation continuity: the customer is following up on a prior chat. The AI should acknowledge the earlier discussion (walnut melamine chipboard) and offer to continue, addressing them by name.
